text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — ACME pilot just confirmed they want a private early-access deployment with dedicated GPU capacity + HSM (customer-managed keys). They asked for a 6-week timeline and a 99.9% inference SLA. Need a cross-team plan (runtime, infra, security, product). Tagging leads.
Samir Khan: Quick clarifying q: which endpoints/features are must-have for MVP? chat streaming, embeddings, reranking? Also need rough qps to size infra.
Maya Patel: MVP = streaming chat, embeddings for search, and a light reranker. Customer estimates initial peak ~40 qps, sustained ~10 qps.
Devin Chen: Runtime callout: streaming + prefix/KV cache enabled. We should serve a quantized 4-bit variant for cost but need kernel fallbacks for older cards. Rough timeline: 2w model tuning, 1w kernel validation on dedicated nodes, then canary. We'll need a dedicated canary path that doesn't affect hosted traffic.
Li Wei: Security checklist: HSM/KMS integration (customer-managed), audit log retention (90d+), and threat model + compliance signoff. We should confirm whether they need SOC2 artifacts or a custom ATO lane. Who owns the cust KMS onboarding?
Priya Rao: Infra notes: to hit perf target we should reserve a pool of 4 x A100-80GB equiv (2 canary, 2 prod standby). Staging must mirror network posture (VPC + private CA). Also plan for prefix-cache warmers and preloaded KV state to avoid cold starts.
Samir Khan: Proposed launch criteria to align on: 1) SLA smoke: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 500ms (for typical prompts); 2) E2E security review signed; 3) Canary run 72h no errors + 2x load test; 4) Regression eval against our prompt set passes (no quality regressions). Agree/disagree?
Devin Chen: Agree with criteria but suggest adjusting latency targets: p50 ~120ms, p95 <=450ms once kernel path validated — depends on prompt length. We'll also add auto-fallback policy to a smaller hosted model if latency spikes.
Maya Patel: Good. Action items: Devin -> model tuning + canary config (ETA 3w), Priya -> capacity reservation & staging setup (ETA 2w), Li -> kick off security review & KMS onboarding doc (ETA 1w), Samir + me -> customer SLA doc & acceptance criteria. I'll create a holistic timeline in the roadmap ticket.
eng-oncall-bot: Deploybot: created canary pipeline ticket #CAN-9423 for ACME private pilot (assigned to Devin, Priya).
Samir Khan: One more: we need a rollback playbook if quality/regression flares during canary. Also confirm billing/commit terms for dedicated pool before sign-off.
Maya Patel: Noted — will draft rollback playbook and loop billing. I'll post an updated timeline tomorrow with dependencies and owners. :thumbsup:
Devin Chen: I'll upload a minimal canary config snippet to the ticket today. Example we discussed:
```
canary:
  percent_traffic: 10
  duration: 72h
  monitors: [latency, error_rate, quality_regressions]
```
Maya Patel: Perfect — thanks everyone. If no objections, we'll lock owners and circulate to ACME by EOD.
